resources.string: Choose a folder containing artist posters
Stop using posters in this folder. Files will not be deleted.

**File naming**

- `Artist.jpg` — exact artist name
- `Artist_live.jpg` — artist name followed by `_` and a suffix
- `AC_DC.jpg`, `AC-DC.jpg`, `AC／DC.jpg` or `ACDC.jpg` — artist name containing characters a file name cannot hold (`\ / : * ? " < > |`)

Supports JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP and MP4.

Only files directly inside the folder are used. Folders are searched in the order added, with exact names first in each folder.
Use these posters when embedded artist artwork is unavailable
